notes: 22 ABI functions plus the fallback reviewed (unoptimized solc 0.8.36 build). consolidate (two overloads, ~500 lines each) and onFlashLoan reviewed by structure, the rest read in full. Loops: 4 explicit, all whiles: _getDebtForLoans (consolidate and the two view helpers), _isValidClearinghouse ('while True', twice per consolidate), _repayDebtForLoans (onFlashLoan), collateralRequired. Implicit: configureDependencies' abi.encode([1, 1, 1, 1]) and the Keycode[4] return as 'while idx < 4' loops (P7, constant size), ids arrays re-encoded for the flash-loan data, copies. Checked: the debt sums (principal at return word 6, interest at word 7 of loans()), the fee overflow check, role checks. No semantic error found.
summary: Faithful, all 4 loops present; the unoptimized build plus the symbolic free-memory pointer make most external calls nameless and leave ~120 dead memory copies.
